title: Evening cash drop timing
cash_evidence: Cash box count shows 420 tokens at close on Saturday.
transaction_evidence: Handwritten tally sheet lists sales totalling 510 tokens for the same day.
hypotheses: Some sales were recorded but cash was removed before counting.
Some cash is from a previous day and the tally is correct.
The tally double-counts one batch of sales.
clarification_target: whether a cash drop was made before counting
expected_evidence: drop log entry or witness statement for a pre-count cash removal

title: Voided receipts still tallied
cash_evidence: Evening cash of 260 tokens against a 100-token morning float, implying 160 tokens taken in.
transaction_evidence: Numbered receipts for the day sum to 205 tokens.
hypotheses: Several cash sales were made without issuing a receipt.
Some receipts were voided but still included in the total.
Part of the evening cash belongs to a separate float.
clarification_target: whether any receipts were voided yet still counted
expected_evidence: voided receipt copies or the receipt book with void markings

title: Mixed float money
cash_evidence: Drawer holds 340 tokens at close; the day started with a 100-token float kept in the same drawer.
transaction_evidence: Till tape lists 290 tokens of sales, with no separate float record.
hypotheses: Float money was mixed with takings and counted as sales.
Some sales never reached the till tape.
A second float was added mid-day and forgotten.
clarification_target: whether float money was mixed with the takings
expected_evidence: a separate float envelope or a float count sheet

title: Double-counted sales batch
cash_evidence: Cash bag holds 610 tokens from Sunday trading.
transaction_evidence: Two tally pages sum to 700 tokens, but both pages list the same morning batch.
hypotheses: One morning batch was written onto both tally pages.
Afternoon cash was banked early and missed from the bag.
A page from Saturday was mixed into Sunday's tallies.
clarification_target: whether one sales batch was recorded on both tally pages
expected_evidence: the two tally pages showing an identical batch line

title: Missing receipt page
cash_evidence: Cash tin holds 185 tokens at close on Tuesday.
transaction_evidence: Receipt book runs from number 31 to 58, but numbers 44 to 47 are missing with no stubs.
hypotheses: A page of receipts was lost along with its cash.
Receipts 44 to 47 were never issued and the book skipped.
Cash for those receipts sits in a separate tin.
clarification_target: what happened to the missing receipt numbers 44 to 47
expected_evidence: the missing stubs, the loose page, or a note explaining the gap
